_note: The ONE identity token source (N55, 2026-07-11). Defined as RELATIONSHIPS (families with intent), PROJECTED into MODES (surfaces). A unified identity is the sure sign of authorship: the site, the manuscripts, the decks and the conceptric renders are one author, not four. Consumers project the same relationships: site_backend emits the screen-dark CSS custom-property block; a .sty generator emits print-light \definecolor (eigenengine milestone); deck themes read deck; bake_graph_snapshot / GROUP_COLOR read graph. Do not hand-edit a consumer's colours -- edit here and re-project. Meta keys are prefixed '_' and are never emitted as tokens.

ink._note: The base: a near-black navy family (origin #0a0e1a). On screen it is the ground the light sits on; on paper it TRANSPOSES to ink -- navy becomes the text colour on cream, it does not photocopy. bg-primary is the ground, bg-secondary the raised plane, bg-card/glass/border are translucent whites (screen) or translucent navy (print) layered on the ground.

accent._note: The gold (origin #c9a96e): the identity's warmth and the engine's voice. base + light (#dfc599) + dim (a 15%-alpha wash for tinted fills) + a derived 3-step warm ramp (warm-1 brightest highlight, warm-2 amber, warm-3 bronze) so decorative variety stays inside the gold family instead of reaching for a generic hue. In graph mode the accent IS the conceptric 'goal' colour.

cool._note: The single cool counterpoint (origin link #7eb8da): links and 'live/structure' signals. base + hover. Deliberately ONE cool -- the sophistication is restraint, not a rainbow. In graph mode it becomes the 'operations/structure' family (#4A90D9).

text._note: Faint/muted reading levels: primary (#e8e6e3 warm off-white on dark; navy ink on light), secondary (#9ca3af), muted (#6b7280). Transposed to near-black on paper.

semantic._note: Meaning-bearing tokens, never decorative. 'refused' is a red RESERVED EXCLUSIVELY for shown-refusal exhibits (the drain refusing an actorless record, the forged-actor 422, def-orphans shown honestly) -- reserving it is what makes red MEAN something instead of decorating. It is deliberately the same #c0392b as the conceptric 'missing' node colour, so a def-orphan on the page and in the graph are one red. 'evidence' is the mono/address texture colour: the tone ids, dates, paths and hashes take (JetBrains Mono), a quiet warm-grey that reads as annotation, tying addresses to the identity rather than leaving them neutral.

screen-dark._note: The website as it stands: dark navy ground, gold accent, cool links. Values mirror the shipped style.css :root byte-for-byte for the surviving tokens (no visual regression) and ADD the warm ramp + semantic tokens. site_backend projects this into every page head as <style id="identity-tokens">.

print-light._note: Manuscripts on paper: the identity TRANSPOSED, not photocopied. Navy becomes the INK (#1a2238 text) on a cream ground (#faf8f3); the gold deepens (#a8863f) so it survives white paper; the cool counterpoint becomes a print structure-blue (#2c6fad, the eigenengine.sty phys blue). Bindings for the eigenengine-milestone .sty generator.

deck._note: Slides: dark like the site but pushed for projection -- deeper ground, max-contrast white text, brighter gold and cool so they hold under a projector's washout.

graph._note: Conceptric renders: a GROUP_COLOR-compatible family (viewer_app.html). accent anchors 'goal' (#f1c40f), link anchors 'operations/structure' (#4a90d9), refused anchors 'missing' (#c0392b -- the def-orphan red, identical to the semantic refused so a def-orphan reads the same on page and in graph), evidence anchors 'citation' (#7f8c8d). The ink family is the graph canvas.
